'''Sacha Swiftbird''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who made a career for herself as a [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

==Biography==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she became a member of the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-affiliated paramilitary group, and following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], she became part of the Rangers' attempts to oppose the new regime. Swiftbird became based in [[Mountain Home]], an underground facility that the Rangers operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]].

In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], she involved herself in an attempt by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] to rescue the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Thi Xon Yimmon]]&mdash;the leader of the [[Whiplash]] resistance group&mdash;from the clutches of the Empire, following Yimmon's capture by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. After Pavan went missing, Swiftbird and Pavan's associates [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]] staged their own attempt to free Yimmon, and they journeyed to [[Kantaros Station]], the facility on which Yimmon was being held, and infiltrated the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] by posing as members of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. After joining forces with Pavan, who had launched his own rescue mission independently, Swiftbird slew the Imperial [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Probus Tesla]] with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] while Tesla was engaged in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with Pavan. Swiftbird and her compatriots then freed Yimmon and left aboard their starship for the world [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where Pavan had business with the planet's [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]].
